Technical 
 Procedure

Equipment:Axial Flow Flue 
 Gases Fan
 PFB 190/125
 Flaket Isuomen Helsinki
Introduction

This document outlines equipment inspection I1, which must be preformed on yearly 
bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed Mohamed Bakr, tested by 
 eng. El-sayed Abd El Rehim Mohamed, reviewed by eng. Omar Hamed 
 Ebrahim, accepted by eng. Farrag Hamza Farrag , approved 
 by eng. Abdel Mohsen Abdel Ghafar: Head Sector of Kafr El-Dawar Power Station.

This document certified by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: head sector of 
 inspection and quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category
Disconnect the power supply of the motor
Be sure that the units & the flue gas fan are stopped
Wear safety helmet, shoes
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required

Cleaning fluid feeler gauge
Suitable keys from 12-46 mm
Filler (indicator)
Work to be Carried Out

Inspection of the bearing 
at evident wear increase radial clearance

Check the coupling 
alignment

Check the tightness of all 
screw (impeller, bearing, motor base)

Check the lubricating 
cycle and clean the lubricating pipes

Isolate mechanically 
the dampers by closing the suction and delivery dampers
